<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#36A18B"/>

  <!-- iOS status bar -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Inter, sans-serif">
    <text x="20" y="29" font-size="15" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <rect x="333" y="19" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="339" y="16" width="4" height="11" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="345" y="13" width="4" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="351" y="10" width="4" height="17" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="319" cy="20" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="24" x2="322" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="14" width="22" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="385" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="364.5" y="16.5" width="16" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top brand area -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="91" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Manrope, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="-1">N26</text>
    <line x1="28" y1="105" x2="362" y2="105" stroke="#CCE3DA" stroke-width="1" opacity=".65"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="79" r="18" fill="#E8F2EE"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="73" r="5" fill="#36A18B"/>
    <ellipse cx="348" cy="85" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#36A18B"/>
  </g>

  <!-- login card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="19" y="130" width="352" height="550" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity=".12"/>
  <rect x="16" y="127" width="352" height="550" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g font-family="Manrope, sans-serif">
    <text x="40" y="183" fill="#000000" font-size="28" font-weight="600">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="40" y="215" fill="#6D6D6D" font-size="15" font-weight="400">Good to see you again, Alex.</text>

    <g>
      <circle cx="53" cy="257" r="17" fill="#BBD8E8"/>
      <text x="53" y="263" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0B1C3F" font-size="14" font-weight="600">A</text>
      <text x="80" y="254" fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="600">alex.morgan@email.com</text>
      <text x="80" y="274" fill="#6D6D6D" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Personal account</text>
      <polyline points="329,255 335,261 329,267" fill="none" stroke="#6D6D6D" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>

    <text x="40" y="323" fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Password</text>
    <rect x="40" y="335" width="304" height="56" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#838388" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="57" y="369" fill="#838388" font-size="16" font-weight="400">Enter your password</text>
    <circle cx="317" cy="360" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#6D6D6D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="311" y1="368" x2="323" y2="352" stroke="#6D6D6D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="40" y="418" fill="#2B697A" font-size="15" font-weight="600">Forgot password?</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="40" y="449" width="304" height="56" rx="28" fill="#0B1C3F"/>
      <text x="192" y="484" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Log in</text>
    </g>

    <line x1="40" y1="533" x2="166" y2="533" stroke="#E9EEF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="192" y="538" text-anchor="middle" fill="#838388" font-size="13" font-weight="500">or</text>
    <line x1="218" y1="533" x2="344" y2="533" stroke="#E9EEF2" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g>
      <rect x="40" y="561" width="304" height="56" rx="28" fill="#E8F2EE"/>
      <circle cx="157" cy="589" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#0B1C3F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="151" y1="585" x2="151" y2="593" stroke="#0B1C3F" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="163" y1="585" x2="163" y2="593" stroke="#0B1C3F" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="153" y1="598" x2="161" y2="598" stroke="#0B1C3F" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <text x="210" y="595" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0B1C3F" font-size="15" font-weight="600">Use Face ID</text>
    </g>

    <text x="192" y="651" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6D6D6D" font-size="12" font-weight="500">Your account is protected with secure login</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Cookie settings -->
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="708" width="334" height="54" rx="10" fill="#2B697A"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="735" r="10" fill="#F2ECE1"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="731" r="2" fill="#2B697A"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="738" r="2" fill="#2B697A"/>
    <text x="70" y="740" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Manrope, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Cookie settings</text>
    <polyline points="337,730 343,735 337,740" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Manrope, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle">
    <g>
      <rect x="48" y="787" width="22" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="52" y1="792" x2="66" y2="792" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="59" y="821">Support</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="143" cy="794" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <polyline points="139,794 142,797 148,790" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="143" y="821">Security</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="239" cy="794" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="239" y1="787" x2="239" y2="801" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="232" y1="794" x2="246" y2="794" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="239" y="821">Language</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <line x1="322" y1="788" x2="340" y2="788" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="322" y1="794" x2="340" y2="794" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="322" y1="800" x2="340" y2="800" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="331" y="821">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="136" y="835" width="118" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
</svg>
